import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths based on benchmark setup
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Feature engineering: separate features from ID and target
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Convert categorical columns to LightGBM-compatible format
categorical_features = ["f_27"]  # f_27 has object dtype with many unique values
X_train[categorical_features] = X_train[categorical_features].astype(str)
X_test[categorical_features] = X_test[categorical_features].astype(str)

# Hold-out validation split with stratification
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"\nValidation split size: {len(y_val_split)}")
print(f"Class distribution in validation: {np.bincount(y_val_split.astype(int))}")

# LightGBM parameters optimized for this dataset
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Prepare data with categorical feature specification
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_split, label=y_train_split, categorical_feature=categorical_features
)
lgb_valid = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_split,
    label=y_val_split,
    reference=lgb_train,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
)

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_valid],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Validate on hold-out set (unbiased estimate)
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_split, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, val_preds)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predictions on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file matching sample submission format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds})
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, 'submission.csv')}")

# Print only the validation metric as required
print(val_auc)
